title: smtp: ID scheme undocumented at architecture level
description: The smtp:{row_id} JMAP ID is a synthetic SQLite row reference documented only in one doc comment. A maintainer seeing these IDs in logs will not know they are local-only, invalidated by row deletion or vacuum, and must not be compared to CID IDs. Add a module-level comment in email/get.rs explaining the two ID spaces and lifecycle guarantees.
